body:
## What it does

Covers what the evidence actually says, which cheaper treatment options exist, and the point at which you should stop reading and see a doctor. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. The cost angle is the point: it names cheaper options alongside the standard ones instead of leaving you to ask.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @GuleidAmina shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
